name: meeting-agenda-load
description: Open a parked meeting agenda on this live call. Voice-only. Pass agenda_id from the queued list in the prompt. An agenda already open on this call is in front of you; go over it without calling this. Returns the agenda, including anything left from earlier calls. Fails if the agenda is expired, finished, or held by another call. Tell the caller you are pulling it up or going over it, as a person would.

inputs.agenda_id: string (required — id of a pending agenda from the queued list)

outputs.agenda: object (agenda snapshot: agendaId, title, topics, role, context, source, sensitivity, scheduledFor, history; scheduledFor and history dates are in the principal's local time)
